name: WhispSynth
description: Whisper generation is constrained by the difficulty of data collection. Because whispered speech has low acoustic amplitude, high-fidelity recording is challenging. In this paper, we introduce WhispSynth, a large-scale multilingual corpus constructed via a novel high-fidelity generative framework. Specifically, we propose a pipeline integrating Differentiable Digital Signal Processing (DDSP)-based pitch-free method with Text-to-Speech (TTS) models.
